title: Vertical transport of polystyrene nanoplastics in natural soils under unsaturated conditions: influence of particle size and texture
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,1687-1699
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN01183C, Paper
Cynthia Rieckhof, Virtudes Martínez-Hernández, Ekkehard Holzbecher, Raffaella Meffe
The infiltration of polystyrene nanoplastics under unsaturated conditions is governed by particle size and soil texture; larger particles show higher retention, while clay loam retains small particles more effectively than sandy loam.
